---
title: Install
toc: false
---

Get Voicenotes from the Connect IQ Store for your [compatible watch](compatibility.qmd).

1. Open [Voicenotes in the Connect IQ Store](https://apps.garmin.com/apps/066dd941-396c-4d0c-b145-a1554e7441b8).
2. Install the app to your watch.
3. Sync your watch, then open **Voicenotes** from its app list.

[Record your first note](index.qmd#record-a-note) · [Build the watch app from source](developer/setup.qmd)
